recruiterCard.summary: Built an end-to-end match outcome predictor: rolling team features, models compared by log loss on a held-out validation set, a FastAPI prediction endpoint and a Streamlit explorer.
impactBullets: Built an ETL pipeline that turns historical match data into rolling team features.
Trained scikit-learn classifiers and compared them by log loss on a held-out validation set.
Served predictions through FastAPI and an interactive Streamlit explorer.
